skills.name: Subtract same-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator, including recognizing a zero numerator as 0.

skills.name: Find and use a common denominator
skills.definition: Find an LCD or convenient common denominator and convert unlike-denominator fractions to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract mixed or whole numbers without regrouping
skills.definition: Handle mixed-number or whole-number subtraction when no fractional regrouping is needed by aligning whole and fraction parts, subtracting whole parts, and recombining the result.

skills.name: Regroup in mixed or whole-number subtraction
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction would be negative, borrow one or more wholes as denominator units, adjust the whole part, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.
